"""validate_rows: positive closes, one row per (date, ticker), requested tickers, sorted."""

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from mdata.types import RawRow
from mdata.validate import validate_rows

ROWS = [
    RawRow(date="2024-01-03", ticker="B", close=20.0),
    RawRow(date="2024-01-02", ticker="B", close=19.0),
    RawRow(date="2024-01-02", ticker="A", close=None),
    RawRow(date="2024-01-03", ticker="A", close=10.0),
]


def test_drops_rows_without_a_close_and_sorts_by_date_then_ticker() -> None:
    assert validate_rows(ROWS) == [
        RawRow(date="2024-01-02", ticker="B", close=19.0),
        RawRow(date="2024-01-03", ticker="A", close=10.0),
        RawRow(date="2024-01-03", ticker="B", close=20.0),
    ]


def test_keeps_only_the_requested_tickers() -> None:
    assert validate_rows(ROWS, ["A"]) == [RawRow(date="2024-01-03", ticker="A", close=10.0)]


def test_drops_zero_and_negative_closes() -> None:
    rows = [
        RawRow(date="2024-01-02", ticker="A", close=0.0),
        RawRow(date="2024-01-03", ticker="A", close=-1.0),
        RawRow(date="2024-01-04", ticker="A", close=0.01),
    ]
    assert validate_rows(rows) == [RawRow(date="2024-01-04", ticker="A", close=0.01)]


def test_later_duplicate_wins() -> None:
    rows = [
        RawRow(date="2024-01-02", ticker="A", close=1.0),
        RawRow(date="2024-01-02", ticker="A", close=2.0),
    ]
    assert validate_rows(rows) == [RawRow(date="2024-01-02", ticker="A", close=2.0)]


def test_unusable_later_duplicate_does_not_replace_a_usable_one() -> None:
    rows = [
        RawRow(date="2024-01-02", ticker="A", close=1.0),
        RawRow(date="2024-01-02", ticker="A", close=None),
    ]
    assert validate_rows(rows) == [RawRow(date="2024-01-02", ticker="A", close=1.0)]

"""validate_rows: positive closes, one row per (date, ticker), requested tickers, sorted."""

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from mdata.types import RawRow
from mdata.validate import validate_rows

ROWS = [
    RawRow(date="2024-01-03", ticker="B", close=20.0),
    RawRow(date="2024-01-02", ticker="B", close=19.0),
    RawRow(date="2024-01-02", ticker="A", close=None),
    RawRow(date="2024-01-03", ticker="A", close=10.0),
]


def test_drops_rows_without_a_close_and_sorts_by_date_then_ticker() -> None:
    assert validate_rows(ROWS) == [
        RawRow(date="2024-01-02", ticker="B", close=19.0),
        RawRow(date="2024-01-03", ticker="A", close=10.0),
        RawRow(date="2024-01-03", ticker="B", close=20.0),
    ]


def test_keeps_only_the_requested_tickers() -> None:
    assert validate_rows(ROWS, ["A"]) == [RawRow(date="2024-01-03", ticker="A", close=10.0)]


def test_drops_zero_and_negative_closes() -> None:
    rows = [
        RawRow(date="2024-01-02", ticker="A", close=0.0),
        RawRow(date="2024-01-03", ticker="A", close=-1.0),
        RawRow(date="2024-01-04", ticker="A", close=0.01),
    ]
    assert validate_rows(rows) == [RawRow(date="2024-01-04", ticker="A", close=0.01)]


def test_later_duplicate_wins() -> None:
    rows = [
        RawRow(date="2024-01-02", ticker="A", close=1.0),
        RawRow(date="2024-01-02", ticker="A", close=2.0),
    ]
    assert validate_rows(rows) == [RawRow(date="2024-01-02", ticker="A", close=2.0)]


def test_unusable_later_duplicate_does_not_replace_a_usable_one() -> None:
    rows = [
        RawRow(date="2024-01-02", ticker="A", close=1.0),
        RawRow(date="2024-01-02", ticker="A", close=None),
    ]
    assert validate_rows(rows) == [RawRow(date="2024-01-02", ticker="A", close=1.0)]


def test_requested_ticker_with_only_unusable_rows_is_a_keyerror_naming_it() -> None:
    rows = [*ROWS, RawRow(date="2024-01-02", ticker="C", close=-3.0)]
    with pytest.raises(KeyError, match="C"):
        validate_rows(rows, ["A", "C"])


def test_keyerror_names_every_missing_ticker_and_not_the_found_ones() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(KeyError) as caught:
        validate_rows(ROWS, ["A", "X", "Y"])
    message = str(caught.value)
    assert "X" in message
    assert "Y" in message
    assert "A," not in message
